name: Machine status
description: (#2918) The read-only `darkmux machine status` verb as an advertised command, so the radio routing seat and the editor panel can route "which models are loaded?" to it instead of refusing. One `procedural.shell` step (procedural-only, so the panel runs it in-process with no mission instance) that calls THIS darkmux through `DARKMUX_BIN` (#2310 P4e) — never whatever `darkmux` is on PATH. Nothing here mutates machine state: `machine eject` and every other mutating verb stay un-advertised on purpose. The verb lists `lms ps` grouped by ownership (darkmux-managed under the `darkmux:` namespace vs user state) plus the registered profile(s) the loaded set matches.

panel.description: Show which models are loaded in LM Studio on this machine right now, grouped by darkmux-managed and user-loaded, with the profile they match. Read-only. The answer to questions like what is loaded, what is resident, or which model is running.
